use: Cathedral conservation programme describes the original four bays, attached chapels, surviving 1937 west portal, baptistry and handmade bricks.
Heritage NSW records the large double brick west arch, eight nave bays, original English bond, sandstone in the foundations and Gothic form.
University of Canterbury archival study identifies additional nave bays, west front, baptistry and vestry completed in 1937.
NSW heritage impact report confirms the labelled building on the 1888 lithograph and State Library copy FL1829507.
